barriers.reason: Cardiac rehab is three early weekday mornings (MWF 8:00 AM), and the patient's only mentioned daytime support (the grandson) is at work all day and only checks in at night, so reliable morning transport to the hospital outpatient center is uncertain.

alternatives.text: Ask cardiac rehab for a later appointment time or a different day that matches an available ride.
If a health condition prevents using fixed-route buses/trains, apply for ADA Paratransit certification (Northern Illinois Transit Authority, 312-663-HELP); note certification is not immediate.

Check coverage: if Medicaid/dual, arrange Medicaid NEMT through the MCO or Transdev; if Medicare only, confirm whether the Medicare Advantage plan has a transportation benefit (original Medicare generally does not cover routine dialysis/rehab rides).
